limitations: Retrospective exploratory analysis; 2025/2026 archive was inspected in prior experiments, not a pristine holdout.
Current policy functions replayed on archive offers, not the actual historical frozen recommendation ledger or T-30 market universe.
Odds observed_at, cancellation announcement times and complete daily offer snapshots are missing. Final settled archive availability may differ from pregame availability.
Missing historical lineups/starters/bullpen/xG/possessions are not fabricated. Models use only full-time scores and team identities.
Independent score distributions omit within-game dependence and explicit overtime/extrainnings processes. Volleyball and unsupported periods/markets are excluded.
Score coefficients refit quarterly with 7-day embargo. Blend weights and selector coefficients use only pre-2024-12-25 out-of-fold predictions and remain frozen.
Same-day final daily league pool is an availability assumption, not an intraday frozen membership replay.
Matched reference is a diagnostic with equal counts within day/league/market/nway/0.10 odds bins, not the unmodified daily highlight policy.
Hit rate excludes void and ungraded outcomes; ROI includes void refunds but excludes unknown settlements. Coverage and price mix are reported separately.
Circular calendar block bootstrap and centered approximate p values assume useful within-block dependence and do not remove researcher selection bias.
